pysideIconify.description: Documentation, completion, checks and icon search for pyside-iconify. Unofficial, not affiliated with Iconify.
pysideIconify.searchIcons.title: Search Icons
pysideIconify.inlineIcons.description: How to show the real icon next to an icon name in the `icon` argument of pyside-iconify calls. The line with the cursor always shows the text so you can edit it.
pysideIconify.inlineIcons.off: Text only. No icon is drawn.
pysideIconify.inlineIcons.iconOnly: Icon only. The icon name is hidden.
pysideIconify.inlineIcons.gutter: Icon in the gutter, before the line number. The text stays.
